text.en:
1. This Act may be cited as the National Land Code (Validation)
Act 2003.
Validation

2. Every act or thing done by the Land Executive Committee of
the Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur under section 42, subsection
56(4) and sections 68A , 75 A , 75 B , 75 E, 75 F , 75 G , 92 B , 92 C , 92 D ,
92E, 92 F , 92 G , 124 A , 129, 204 B , 204 E, 433 B  and 433 E of the
National Land Code before the commencement of this Act until
the coming into operation of the delegation of powers under
section 13 of the National Land Code [ P.U. (B) 108/2003 ] that
would have been lawful if the Land Executive Committee had
been delegated to perform such act or thing under those provisions
is hereby validated and declared to have been lawfully done.
DICETAK OLEH
PERCETAKAN NASIONAL MALAYSIA BERHAD,
CAW ANGAN KUALA LUMPUR
BAGI PIHAK DAN DENGAN PERINTAH KERAJAAN MALAYSIA
